convenienceStoreDecision.source: 用户要求便利店商品、状态扩展、食物能量与品牌品质；香烟50元一盒，显著恢复精力和减压但损失健康。
convenienceStoreDecision.catalog: 12 fictional products; meal/snack/drink/cigarette, each with basic/standard/premium tiers
convenienceStoreDecision.migration: Strictly preserve supported 1.0–1.6 saves; add initial needs and empty inventory, without recomputing past consumption

novelEnergyAndProductImagesDecision.source: 用户要求小说转场基础精力倍率0.1、50%为身体状态分界，生成商品图片；追加学习等交互影响精力与精神，并明确低精力不限制转场。
novelEnergyAndProductImagesDecision.energy: Hundredth-unit arithmetic; original route energy multiplied by 0.1 and departure conditions; actual spending is capped at remaining energy
novelEnergyAndProductImagesDecision.lowEnergyPolicy: Novel scene changes remain available at zero energy. Energy-consuming activities retain affordability checks; rest and free observation remain available.
novelEnergyAndProductImagesDecision.morale: 0–100 mental state, legacy default 70; studies deplete it, rest and authored relaxing activities restore it; not double-counted in travel multiplier
novelEnergyAndProductImagesDecision.migration: Strict 1.0–1.7 migration preserving all prior fields and inventory; no historical activity resettlement
novelEnergyAndProductImagesDecision.images: 12 independent built-in image_gen transparent PNGs, fixed product-ID allowlist, original pixels embedded once and shared by shelf/backpack
novelEnergyAndProductImagesDecision.delivery: same V2 PNG and helper IIFE; existing characters, Soyo, backgrounds and phone preserved

academicChoiceDecision.source: 用户要求增加初始专业和学科选择，使后续学习目标与提升跟随所选方向。
academicChoiceDecision.selection: 8 majors, 3 subjects each; explicit selection once per chat; no automatic selection for new or legacy saves

academicCurriculumDecision.source: 用户要求一个专业包含多门学科、每周课程表与各科学习进度，并允许图书馆及书店跨专业阅读产生概率性收获和身心代价。
academicCurriculumDecision.selection: 8 majors with 3 subjects each; choose one major once, choose the subject separately for each learning action

locationServicesDecision.catalog: 10 deterministic services at existing cafes, commercial district, sports ground, parks and promenade

llmActionsAndBackpackDecision.source: 用户明确要求常驻相邻交互、提高LLM行动权限，移除人物入口并加入独立背包、打包与赠送
llmActionsAndBackpackDecision.supersedes: 历史的耗时活动仅由按钮执行，以及背包嵌入状态页；不删除手机联系人或角色立绘

llmActionsAndBackpackDecision.gift: 扣实际库存、按情境增加既有联系人亲密度，不重复营养收益

interactionEventsDecision.source: 用户要求移除遮挡正文的常驻操作、改为悬浮窗；交互有80%概率询问事件，并添加进度动画
interactionEventsDecision.supersedes: 阅读层固定两行地点操作；地点工具栏和相邻入口保留
interactionEventsDecision.accept: 调用模型生成有实际影响的事件，原交互与事件一起保存
interactionEventsDecision.decline: 不调用模型，正常完成原交互
interactionEventsDecision.progress: 1200ms短动画，未确认状态不写入存档

socialCharactersDecision.source: 用户要求陌生人交流展示立绘、对白在原显示框可展开；手机确认角色姓名立绘与主要人物；生成短介绍须用户许可并注入此人出场对白。
socialCharactersDecision.dialogue: Default fold inside original reader, expandable; preserve narration, events and raw saved dialogue.
socialCharactersDecision.profile: Explicit phone save confirms stable identity/name/local portrait and optional summary as a main character in the current chat.
socialCharactersDecision.introduction: Only explicit permission button requests the model. Include at most six relevant turns/2400 characters. Return an editable draft without state effects.
